Where: [X.Y] is the branch name, for example: [3.13].

auto_merge.commit_title: gh-140301: Fix memory leak in subinterpreter `PyConfig` cleanup (#140303)

review_comments.body: Why not call this in `PyInterpreterState_Delete` itself?
Thank you for the review! If I understand correctly, you're suggesting to add `PyConfig_Clear` in `PyInterpreterState_Delete` before `free_interpreter`.

```suggestion
Fix memory leak of ``PyConfig`` in subinterpreters.
```
